Doc ID: RM-DOC-0193
Title: Northern channel closed (copy)
Outlet: Serpent Canal Authority
Publication Date: 2025-03-02
Source Type: official_notice
Event ID: EVT-A
Country: Asvald; Brenmark; Gravia
Sector: electronics; automotive
Reliability Tier: 1

NOTICE TO SHIPPING. The Serpent Canal Authority has closed the northern channel of the Serpent Canal to all commercial traffic from 2025-03-02 after the grounding of the bulk carrier Gullfaxi near kilometre 41.

The southern channel is also closed while divers inspect the canal bed. No vessel may transit either channel until further notice.

The closure is expected to last at least eight weeks. Salvage crews from Port Vell are on site and a further notice will follow when a reopening date is set.
